caps.note: GLOBAL_MAX bounds a single position, not the pool. deposit() does not check it. Because STARTER_CAP + 2 * lifetimeRevenue exceeds it, GLOBAL_MAX binds every advance here.

admin.purpose: deposit, withdraw free funds, pause, register splitters
admin.note: No longer the agent. Role rotation is the next step.

agent.purpose: owns the splitter, withdraws its revenue, administers its own contract
agent.note: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the splitter is the fix: it makes the agent key recoverable and payout redirectable.

payer.purpose: payout destination for the agent above; also the demo buyer
payer.note: Testnet only. In production payout and payer would be separate.

settler.purpose: signs EIP-3009 payments in the hosted seller; holds a small float

notes: Everything here is Arc TESTNET. The contracts do not exist on Arc mainnet.
The splitter is a minimal proxy clone of splitterImpl, deployed by the factory.

This is the second deployment. The first (vault 0xc9497Ec4) had a splitter-admin lock where nobody could grant or revoke a role on a splitter, fixing it required a contract change, and it is superseded.
The agent holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on its own splitter so a lost key is recoverable and payout can be redirected.
